components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--font-geist-sans, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 24px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1),background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1),color 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1);background:var(--background,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#171717);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#171717) 20%,transparent);}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--color-primary,#00263c);color:white;box-shadow:0 6px 18px #00263c20;}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-secondary,#30526b);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-secondary:active{transform:scale(.98);}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
The existing workspace provides a quiet, task-focused frame for arranging meetings. Geist sans, adaptive foreground colors, native fields, and flat agenda dividers carry the scheduler; navy identifies primary actions and the selected agenda filter.

This record covers the shipped scheduler and its shared workspace header, not the separate marketing surface. It describes the browser-local preview and does not prescribe future account interfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Native form controls with visible focus.
Flat agenda rows and restrained tonal panels.

rules.name: The Adaptive Neutral Rule
rules.body: Derive muted text, strokes, and panel fills from the current foreground so the workspace follows the device color scheme.

rules.name: The Flat Agenda Rule
rules.body: Separate meeting rows with fine dividers; reserve shadows for shared button hover states.

dos: Do retain visible labels, native date/time controls, and keyboard focus outlines.
Do preserve the single-column mobile flow and wrap action groups and navigation.
Do use foreground-derived tones for helper text and dividers.
donts: Don’t replace agenda rows with elevated cards.
Don’t import the marketing display font into scheduler headings.
